platforms.name: Mobile
platforms.detailedDescription: A mobile application built entirely from scratch in a record time of just 11 days. The app functions as a pocket Point of Sale (POS) terminal, allowing users to issue charges and receive payments. The core flow simulates a credit card machine, featuring native tokenization via Pagar.me, camera-based code scanning, and manual multi-step entry. The architecture was structured using the Bare Workflow (React Native CLI) and includes a strict onboarding process accommodating both individual (CPF) and corporate (CNPJ) accounts.
learnings: Extreme agile delivery capability, focusing on core requirements to architect and finalize a native financial app MVP in just 11 days.
Native hardware integration (camera) and tokenization gateways (Pagar.me) to build robust Point of Sale (POS) receiving flows.
Smart reuse of logical structures and UI components to accelerate product validation and delivery without sacrificing financial security standards.
